items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I remember him in Kansas City... between him and Jimmy Blanton, they really fascinated me when it come to playing bass.

items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Very outstanding bass player. Phenomenol. The technique he had on the string bass was something else.
